description: Source code for the extended FLASH HAL module driver for STM32F4 microcontrollers, providing functions for memory erase, programming, protection, and option bytes management.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs a mass erase or erases specified sectors in FLASH memory, with polling.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Starts a sector or mass erase in FLASH memory with interrupt.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs option bytes such as write protection, read protection, user config, BOR levels.

methods.name: FLASH_FlushCaches
methods.description: Flushes the instruction and data caches.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced option bytes like PCROP, boot configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetBank2WRP
methods.description: Returns write protection option bytes for bank 2.
